brief: The Exordium: a broken stair forks around a dark rock outcrop; left branch climbs to a narrow warm opening, right ends at a missing slab. One dominant upward diagonal and a clear void. No character.

The Exordium: a sheltered cold campsite below an overhanging rock; one small ember bed beneath a sloping cloth stretched between two fitted supports. A pale runoff line outside the shelter, quiet asymmetry.

The Exordium: a heavy tilted stone door caught half open in fractured rock, a muted copper latch and broad warm light wedge beneath it. Thick door edge and one clean triangular dark recess; no symbols.

The City: a small suspended shuttered market balcony fixed between two stone towers, one asymmetric muted copper cloth canopy and sagging but connected suspension beams. Dominant balcony plane; no merchant or text.

The City: a narrow dry walkway crosses a broad dark aqueduct arch, high buildings simplified into two quiet masses beyond. Stone thickness and continuous supports, one clean pale route cuts the scene diagonally.
The City: a recessed rooftop shelter reached by three broad steps, an offset folded sage canopy and one warm lantern inside. Stable curved parapet, asymmetric copper cloth, quiet dark city backdrop.
